help:
Tired of quantity over quality? Tired of feeling abandoned? Too bad. But at least you've got tiki!
Type /tiki to open the menu and hunt down those strange objects hidden in all those maps.
'/tikitoggle' to enable or disable this resource for you. '/tikimap' to toggle showing map info in the chatbox when loading into map, if the map has any. '/tikiblips' to toggle blips on and off on the radar. '/tikitext' to toggle showing pickup info in the chatbox when a tiki is collected. '/tikireset mapname' to reset tiki on a specific map.
New tiki can be collected on a new map every week, as long as all previous tiki were found. Are you creating or submitting a custom map that you believe deserves tiki? Contact me.
- Mawfeen
